test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the theme selected by RBI as the 2022 theme for Financial Literacy week?

options.text: Credit Discipline and Credit from Formal Institutions

solution:
The correct answer is " **Go Digital, Go Secure**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• RBI selected the theme " **Go Digital, Go Secure**" for Financial Literacy week of** 2022.**
 
• Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has been conducting Financial Literacy Week (FLW) every year since 201
